sql: SELECT (SELECT started_at FROM live_paper_twins WHERE twin_tag='Dmmsell10_pt4') AS epoch_start, (SELECT count(*) FROM live_paper_parity_events e WHERE e.twin_tag='Dmmsell10_pt4') AS parity_all, (SELECT count(*) FROM live_paper_parity_events e WHERE e.twin_tag='Dmmsell10_pt4' AND e.recorded_at >= (SELECT started_at FROM live_paper_twins WHERE twin_tag='Dmmsell10_pt4')) AS parity_in_window, (SELECT count(*) FROM paper_trades p WHERE p.strategy='Dmmsell10_pt4') AS paper_trades, (SELECT count(*) FROM live_orders o WHERE o.strategy='Dmmsell10') AS live_orders, (SELECT count(*) FROM live_paper_parity_events) AS parity_total
